name: David-MD
description: A multi-purpose WhatsApp bot — 162 commands, deploy your own in a couple of minutes.

SESSION_ID.description: Only needed if you did NOT edit config.js. Paste the session ID the pairing site sent you on WhatsApp — it starts with David~ and is about 2500 characters.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Your WhatsApp number with country code, digits only (e.g. 2348012345678). Leave blank and the bot uses the paired account.

OWNER_NAME.description: The name shown as the bot's owner.

MODE.description: private = only you can use it. public = anyone can.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Only needed for the .ai and .chatbot commands — get one at console.anthropic.com. Every other command works without it.

DATABASE_URL.description: Strongly recommended on Heroku. Heroku wipes the filesystem every day, so without a Postgres database your settings reset daily. Add the free Heroku Postgres add-on and this fills in automatically.
